purpose: Five distinct original dark glass dashboard concepts inspired only by the visual language of the user's reference.

concepts.name: AZURE
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE original high-fidelity desktop DashAI dashboard design concept. This is part of a requested set of FIVE DISTINCT directions. User likes a luxury dark dashboard visual language: deep blue backgrounds, controlled luminous gradients, soft rounded translucent-looking panels, bright accent icons, layered surfaces and white typography. Borrow ONLY this design language. Do NOT reproduce the reference's layout, jellyfish, welcome hero, financial charts, numbers, gauges or floating sculptures. Create an independently designed serious application interface, visually beautiful, expressive and usable. No jellyfish or other hero illustration anywhere.

Canvas: landscape 1920x1200 or similar 16:10, a complete edge-to-edge straight-on app screenshot. No device frame, no browser window, no collage, no presentation slide. Crisp readable Russian labels, 15-16px equivalent text, clear white text on sufficiently opaque navy panels, not low-contrast text floating on gradients. Subtle blue-purple ambient light behind panels, restrained depth, shadows, thin glass edges, beautiful local luminous icon treatments. Vary panel geometry per direction.

Product: “DashAI”, project “Обновление интерфейса”. Local tasks, project knowledge and human review of coding-agent work, not analytics for money. Existing project areas “Задачи”, “Документация”, “Карта проекта”, “Версии”, “История”, “Коннекторы”. One primary action “Новая задача”, search “Поиск задач”, filters “Исполнитель” and “Приоритет”, task view toggle “Доска / Список”. These controls are thoughtfully placed for the layout, not all repeated in several places.
Synthetic data, SAME across concepts: “8 задач · 2 в работе · 2 на проверке · 1 блокировка”.
Five statuses with text, never color alone: “Очередь”, “В работе”, “Проверка”, “Готово”, “Блокировка”.
Exactly eight tasks, two in queue, two in progress, two in review, one done, one blocked:
DA-101 “Поиск по документации”, Codex, Очередь.
DA-102 “Навигация по проектам”, Claude, Очередь.
DA-103 “Новый вид карточек”, Вы, В работе.
DA-104 “Сохранение фильтров”, Codex, В работе.
DA-105 “Проверка экспорта PDF”, Вы, Проверка.
DA-106 “Контраст и фокус”, Claude, Проверка.
DA-107 “История изменений”, Codex, Готово.
DA-108 “Настройка коннектора”, Не назначен, Блокировка, reason “Ожидает настройки”.
Assignee names are identity labels only. NO online dots or live agent claims. Task card contains ID, title, type, assignee and optional priority; no excess metadata. Review inspector if present shows “Критерии готовности” with meaningful checklist “Все разделы в PDF”, “Схемы читаются”, “Ссылки работают”; evidence caption “Отчёт автора”, not independent proof of tests. Small footnote “Концепт · демоданные”.
Keep task content visible and central. Avoid giant greeting, dashboard template copied from the reference, stock-art background, huge empty unused area, repeated navigation, percent AI efficiency, revenue, sales, arbitrary charts, 3D hero objects, glowing neon text, garbled Cyrillic or tiny label soup. The image should feel like one outstanding polished design made specifically for this product.
01 / AZURE — Rich navy and royal blue, a tactile glass task workspace. Large main board with 5 columns and eight cards, left sidebar 205px containing logo, project switcher and meaningful project navigation. Header extremely compact, top-right blue “Новая задача”. A thin horizontal summary ribbon above the board shows the counts with small glowing blue icons, NOT four large KPI boxes. Large dark sapphire canvas, medium blue cards subtly brighter than columns, background pools of electric blue only at lower-left and upper-right. Card radius 16px; sidebar selection a blue glass capsule. Two card rows fit with generously readable task headings. A narrow secondary rail at very bottom shows links “Документация”, “Последние изменения” as inline shortcuts, not extra giant panels. Board occupies 75% of meaningful content height. Active DA-103 card has fine bright blue edge. Elegant small lavender status dots with text. White typography calm and confident; immersive dimensional blue aesthetic, distinctive elegant simple geometric DashAI mark, no hero art. Footer tiny “01 / AZURE”.
